verdict.rationale: Rootly ships a built-in conversational AI assistant (Rootly AI) accessible in web app, Slack (/rootly summary, Q&A), and mobile, capable of answering questions, generating summaries/retrospective drafts, finding related incidents, and taking action via connectors (AWS, Atlassian) — a clear delegate-to-assistant experience. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the AI assistant's task delegation quality (community evidence largely covers pricing/Slack-centric complaints, not the AI assistant itself).
